reasoning_content:
The error is for `valuator_explanation` (Erläuterung) required when unfeasible && valuation_finished. The seed sets `unfeasibility_explanation` but validation requires `valuator_explanation`. Simplest fix: in seed, don't combine unfeasible with valuation_finished, or set valuator_explanation. I'll set valuator_explanation when unfeasible.

Actually simpler: set `valuator_explanation: Faker::Lorem.paragraph`. Let me patch.

action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''      feasibility: %w[undecided unfeasible feasible feasible feasible feasible].sample,
      unfeasibility_explanation: Faker::Lorem.paragraph,'''
new='''      feasibility: %w[undecided unfeasible feasible feasible feasible feasible].sample,
      unfeasibility_explanation: Faker::Lorem.paragraph,
      valuator_explanation: Faker::Lorem.paragraph,'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
grep -n "valuator_explanation" db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb
